errors.text_span: die in alphabetischer Reihenfolge von Japan bis Frankreich angeordnet sind
errors.evidence: The bars are sorted in descending order of their value, not in alphabetical order.

errors.text_span: Alle Balken haben eine blaue Farbe, mit Ausnahme des Polen-Balkens, der eine purpurne Farbe hat.
errors.evidence: The bars for OECD and EU27 are colored in two different shades of purple/mauve, while the bar for Poland is blue. Most other bars are also blue. The description incorrectly identifies which bar is highlighted by a different color.
The bar for Japan reaches approximately 88%, which is below the 90% grid line, not 92%.
The bar for France is the lowest, at approximately 59%, which is just below the 60% grid line, not 69%.
The bars for Schweden, Südkorea, and Dänemark reach approximately 80%, 79%, and 78% respectively, not 85%.
The bar for EU27 reaches approximately 70%, not 76%.
The bar for the USA reaches approximately 69%, not 82%.
The bar for Italy reaches approximately 67%, not 72%.
The bar for Spain reaches approximately 66%, not 74%.

errors.text_span: Ein blauer Punkt befindet sich auf der Höhe des Balkens für die Vereinigten Königreich.
errors.evidence: The blue dot is located at the 60% mark on the y-axis, which is below the top of the bar for the United Kingdom (which is at approximately 68%). The description incorrectly states the dot is at the height of the bar.
The description omits the approximate values for the bars corresponding to Deutschland, Polen, and Vereinigtes Königreich. The prompt asks for a description of each bar.
